source: saved prob/pred arrays and barr_states.csv from the 884-case campaign

selection_rule.A: ACCEPTED case with the largest positive Dice change; ties broken by ascending sample_id
selection_rule.B: ACCEPTED case with the largest negative Dice change, restricted to cases whose change is < 0; ties broken by ascending sample_id
selection_rule.C: REJECTED case with the highest S_omega acceptance probability, i.e. the most borderline rejection; ties broken by ascending sample_id
selection_rule.D: case the router did not select, whose global Dice is closest to its own cohort median; ties broken by ascending sample_id

rejected_delta_note: every REJECTED case has delta == 0 exactly, because the refined output is discarded and the global mask retained
legend_note: A rejected candidate still executed the refiner and the safety head; only its output was discarded, so its BARR panels equal Global by construction. That equality is the rejection, not a missing panel.
